description: This is a Java source file containing a helper class 'PoliciesSnapshotTestHelper' used for testing Akka persistence snapshots related to policy services. The class provides methods to retrieve maximum snapshots, all snapshots in ascending order, and convert snapshot data to domain objects, primarily used in testing scenarios.
